name: Duplicate Finder
author: Viboplr
description: Find duplicate tracks in your library — the same song downloaded twice or sitting in two folders — and reclaim space by deleting the extra copies. Grouping is diacritic-insensitive (Björk = Bjork) and can optionally require duration and file-size to match too.

permissionReasons.library:read: Find tracks that share a title and artist, and rescan when tracks are added or removed
permissionReasons.playback:control: Play a copy so you can compare it before deleting

viewHeader.subtitle: Find songs held more than once and reclaim the space
